User is able to enter the Frida Mag Office Demo space on all clients.
Unity iOS - Ensure that the user is able to view the space in AR, and resolve the anchor successfully.

Viewer Avatar - Custom
User is able to upload and select a custom avatar on the Web.

Viewer Avatar - Custom
Users appear as their uploaded custom avatar across all platforms.

Viewer Avatar - Generic
Users appear as their selected generic avatar across all platforms.

Creator Avatar - Camera
- Web and Unreal creators appear as 3D camera models across all platforms.
- Unity iOS creators appear as mobile device (iPad) model across all platforms.

- Mag Office US site model is visible on Web & Unreal.
- No visual artifacts, and no obvious shadow/color mismatches.
- Lighting between Web and Unreal matches as closely as possible.

Existing Assets
All existing 3D and 2D assets in the space are visible across all clients and look great (paintings, pedestals, carpets, anim dinosaur, Frida video, etc)

Existing Assets
Web - Move, scale and rotate an existing asset in the space, ensure the same translation occurs across all other clients.

Existing Assets
Unreal - Move, scale and rotate an existing asset in the space, ensure the same translation occurs across all other clients.

New Assets - Library
Web - Add an asset from the library into the 3D view, then:
- Ensure the asset appears across all clients.
- Move, Scale & Rotate it, ensure translation across all clients.
- Delete the 3D asset from the space, ensure it deletes across all clients.

New Assets - Library
Unreal - Add an asset from the library into the 3D view, then:
- Ensure the asset converts to an OKO object and appears across all clients.
- Move, Scale & Rotate it, ensure translation across all clients.
- Delete the 3D asset from the space, ensure it deletes across all clients.

New Assets - Sketchfab
Web - Add an asset from Sketchfab into the 3D view, then:
- Ensure the asset appears across all clients.
- Move, Scale & Rotate it, ensure translation across all clients.
- Delete the 3D asset from the space, ensure it deletes across all clients.

Gaussian Splat
Validate a Gaussian Splat asset (Dern the Dino) is visible across all clients, and looks as expected.

AR Validation

- Ensure the holocap assets can be viewed in AR.
- Ensure there is no representation of those assets on Web or Unreal.

User is able to add items to shopping cart. 
Select the drop down menu and then pick a M or a L variant. 
Click 'Add To Bag' and validate the following:  
- A notification pops up at the bottom of the screen:  "Item added to bag. There is 1 item in your bag". Click X to dismiss the notification.  
- There is a red icon showing 1 item in the shopping bag icon on the Right menu bar.
Then click 'Add to Bag' again and validate that:
- A 2nd notification pops up at the bottom of the screen:  "Item added to bag. There are 2 items in your bag". Click X to dismiss the notification.  
- There is a red icon showing 2 items in the shopping bag icon on the Right menu bar.

- Select 'Checkout' and ensure a new browser tab opens and directs the user to Shopify.

Ensure there are no performance drops when performing the dry run. If any drops were observed, record a profile using the Performance tab of the Chrome Development Tools, add to a bug ticket, and also upload the file here:
Demo Dry Run Performance Data

Chrome Development Tools - Press F12 and go to the Performance tab. Before hitting record, go to the "Check Your Settings" page. Hit record, then enter the space and move to the Office Atrium. Stop recording after 60 seconds and save the profile.
